messages.text: BL-2069 🎵 in progress — Every briefing send commits its sent marker: from 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-07 each logged commit of docs/briefings/.sent.json failed - three times because the daemon's root was relative and `git add` ran inside docs/briefings with a repo-relative path, twice on a held index lock - so the markers reached git days late by hand, and 10-07's not at all
